description: Explicit memory save-intent corpus (V4 plan sections 3.2, 6.2, 19-phase-0, 20.1). expect=save means the message is an explicit save command that must be captured; expect=reject means nothing may be written. The anchored-regex fallback is deliberately conservative: unanchored phrasings like 'I want you to remember...' are rejected for now and deferred to the phase-2 write-intent planner (tagged known_conservative_miss).
